purpose: Stop agents from wasting cycles or causing damage when stuck.

stuck_signatures.name: same_tool_same_error
stuck_signatures.trigger: same command/tool fails with same error beyond retry budget

stuck_signatures.name: stale_browser_refs
stuck_signatures.trigger: browser action fails on stale/missing refs twice
stuck_signatures.action: fresh snapshot; then switch to direct evidence route

stuck_signatures.name: no_new_evidence
stuck_signatures.trigger: three consecutive turns produce no new artifact/test/evidence
stuck_signatures.action: stop and pick smaller verifiable task

required_ledger_event: Every circuit breaker must append action-ledger event with phase=escalate.
safety: Fail closed; do not bypass approvals, secrets, or production safeguards.
